import ctypes

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_wavelet_type structure
class GslWaveletType(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("name", ctypes.c_char_p),
        ("init", ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_int, 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_double)), 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t), 
                                   ctypes.POINTER(ctypes.c_size_t), 
                                   ctypes.c_size_t))
    ]

# Retrieve the gsl_wavelet_haar and gsl_wavelet_haar_centered objects
try:
    gsl_wavelet_haar = ctypes.cast(ctypes.addressof(gsl.gsl_wavelet_haar), ctypes.POINTER(GslWaveletType)).contents
    gsl_wavelet_haar_centered = ctypes.cast(ctypes.addressof(gsl.gsl_wavelet_haar_centered), ctypes.POINTER(GslWaveletType)).contents
except AttributeError as e:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to retrieve wavelet objects. Ensure the GSL library is correctly installed and accessible.") from e

def assert_test():
    try:
        # Validate the name of each wavelet type
        haar_name = gsl_wavelet_haar.name
        haar_centered_name = gsl_wavelet_haar_centered.name

        assert haar_name is not None, "Wavelet name is null for gsl_wavelet_haar"
        assert haar_centered_name is not None, "Wavelet name is null for gsl_wavelet_haar_centered"

        # Decode names safely
        haar_name_decoded = haar_name.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")
        haar_centered_name_decoded = haar_centered_name.decode("utf-8", errors="replace")

        assert haar_name_decoded == "haar", f"Wavelet name mismatch for gsl_wavelet_haar: {haar_name_decoded}"
        assert haar_centered_name_decoded == "haar-centered", f"Wavelet name mismatch for gsl_wavelet_haar_centered: {haar_centered_name_decoded}"

        # Validate the initialization function pointers are non-null
        assert gsl_wavelet_haar.init is not None, "Initialization function pointer is null for gsl_wavelet_haar"
        assert gsl_wavelet_haar_centered.init is not None, "Initialization function pointer is null for gsl_wavelet_haar_centered"

        print("All tests passed successfully.")
    except AssertionError as e:
        print(f"Assertion failed: {e}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Unexpected error occurred: {e}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
